item.title: Kids and teens are going to AI chatbots for advice. How can parents make sure this is safe?
item.description: Last week, Australian Federal Police Commissioner Krissy Barrett warned artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots are not a sufficient replacement for human support for children. The comment was in response to a recent Adelaide University study that found more than one in three Australian children turn to AI chatbots for support when they are sexually victimized online or otherwise tell nobody at all. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Museum releases historical photos of island where Amelia Earhart may have crashed
item.description: Images from New Zealand aerial survey of Nikumaroro in 1938 offer new clues over aviator’s disappearance A New Zealand museum has released nearly 50 photos from a 1938 aerial survey of the island where Amelia Earhart is believed to have crash-landed, offering amateur sleuths new evidence to scour for traces of the pioneering aviator and her plane. The black-and-white images were published by the Air Force Museum of New Zealand after renewed interest in one of the biggest mysteries of the 20th century, spurred by a US expedition to the Pacific atoll of Nikumaroro in search of new clues… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Oliver Holmes

item.title: Queensland protects 396,000 hectares of cattle stations, safeguarding wetlands and threatened birds
item.description: Queensland proudly announces the acquisition of three significant cattle properties, expanding its protected area network by almost 396,000 hectares. These lands are essential for wildlife conservation, providing critical habitats for various threatened species. Funded by the federal government through a biodiversity initiative, this move contributes to Australia's ambitious target of safeguarding 30 percent of its land and oceans by 2030. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
